finding.claim: Checkout follows an intermediate symlink when writing files, so on a case-insensitive filesystem a tree containing symlink 'A' and directory 'a/' with a file under it writes outside the work tree (arbitrary file write as the user, e.g. ~/.zshrc or LaunchAgents).
finding.source: Untrusted tree entries from a remote repository (symlink entry 'A' with relative target such as '../..', plus blob 'a/<file>'), delivered via clone/checkout/pull of an attacker-controlled repo on macOS or Windows-with-symlinks.
finding.sink: open(target_path, 'wb') in build_file_from_blob (index.py:1916) reached through os.makedirs/os.path.exists on the parent in build_index_from_tree (index.py:2229-2232) and _ensure_parent_dir_exists (index.py:2371-2396, used at :2629 by update_working_tree's add path).

trace.note: validate_path only checks element names; passes 'A' and 'a/<file>'
validate_path_element_ntfs rejects .git spellings and reserved names only; no case-collision check
full_path computed for each entry in tree order (uppercase 'A' sorts before 'a')
os.path.exists(dirname) follows symlink 'A' on case-insensitive FS, so makedirs is skipped
update_working_tree add path: _ensure_parent_dir_exists uses exists/isdir, which follow symlinks; no symlink rejection
build_file_from_blob lstat's only the leaf target
leaf-symlink guard only; intermediate symlink not checked
open(target_path,'wb') follows the intermediate symlink and writes outside the work tree

finding.guards_checked: validate_path and NTFS/HFS validators (no case-collision check); leaf-symlink replacement at index.py:1904-1910 (leaf only); _ensure_parent_dir_exists (no symlink check); ignorecase handling at index.py:2883-2892 (rename detection only); core.protectNTFS/protectHFS defaults (do not block). Not executed: no repro run on a case-insensitive FS; end-to-end porcelain.clone -> checkout call chain not fully confirmed.
